class.name: PerceptionComponent
class.brief_description: Attachable perception node for agent awareness.
class.description: Handles visual cone, hearing radius, and confidence decay for agents. Maintains PerceptionState and syncs to owner Agent. Attach as child of Agent node.

method.name: set_visual_range
method.description: Set visual detection range in world units.

method.name: set_visual_angle
method.description: Set visual cone angle in degrees.

method.name: update_perception
method.description: Update perception state from world data each tick.

method.name: on_hearing_event
method.description: Process a hearing event at given origin with loudness multiplier.

method.name: can_see_target
method.description: Returns true if target is currently perceived with sufficient confidence.

signal.name: target_detected
signal.description: Emitted when a new hostile target is detected.

signal.name: target_lost
signal.description: Emitted when a previously detected target fades from perception.
